headlines.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns as U.S. ambassador to Greece amid misconduct allegations
headlines.description: U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle, once a top Trump campaign surrogate, resigned amid misconduct allegations, which she said were false. Guilfoyle's announcement came shortly after the new White House press secretary, Katie Zacharia, told reporters that the ambassador was asked to step down.

headlines.title: Trump attacks Rep. Ilhan Omar and Senate hopeful Abdul El-Sayed at Ohio rally
headlines.description: The crowd chanted “deport” at several points as Trump denigrated Omar, who was born in Somalia and immigrated to the U.S., and El-Sayed, who was born in Michigan.

headlines.title: Duane Davis gets 40 years to life for Tupac Shakur’s murder
headlines.description: The man convicted of orchestrating rapper Tupac Shakur’s killing in 1996 has been sentenced to 40 years to life in prison.

headlines.title: Diesel futures jump, signaling higher prices to come despite Trump’s Russia deal
headlines.description: Diesel futures traded sharply higher Tuesday, as doubts mounted that the Trump administration’s recent maneuvers to lower prices would make much of an impact.

headlines.title: Romance scammers are getting harder to catch. The consequences are costly.
headlines.description: For people looking for love online, a match with a scammer could cost them their life savings.

headlines.title: Bryan Cranston mourns ‘Breaking Bad’ co-star RJ Mitte: ‘My sweet son’
headlines.description: Emmy winning actor Bryan Cranston on Monday lamented the death of “Breaking Bad” co-star RJ Mitte, calling the late actor and disability advocate “my sweet son.”

headlines.title: Team Arrives at Remote Island in Search of Amelia Earhart’s Plane
headlines.description: After a five-day boat ride, the Purdue University research team has arrived at the remote island of Nikamuroro in the South Pacific to search for Amelia Earhart’s missing plane. Once on the island, the team will cut their way through thick vegetation to get to a lagoon where it is believed the plane has been resting for nearly 90 years. NBC’s Tom Costello reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Clavicular’s accuser drops sexual assault claims from civil lawsuit amid MA criminal rape case
headlines.description: A woman who accused “looksmaxxing” influencer Clavicular of raping her at his family’s Cape Cod home last May has refiled her civil lawsuit and dropped the sexual assault allegations against him, a move her lawyer said was intended to avoid interfering with a pending Massachusetts criminal case in connection with the encounter.

headlines.title: Anthropic says its A.I. model submitted a false cold case tip to Philadelphia police
headlines.description: Artificial intelligence research company Anthropic says one of its models generated a bogus tip about an unsolved murder and submitted it to Philadelphia police.
